summary: Free Radical's fast arcade FPS trilogy; use modern PS4/PS5 classics for the PS2-only first game and Xbox backward compatibility for the later Xbox versions when fidelity and preservation are the priority.

primary.why: The first TimeSplitters was PS2-only, and the 2024 PS4/PS5 classic release adds trophy support, rewind, and improved loading times.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use PCSX2 or PS2 hardware only for original-disc comparison.

entries.title: TimeSplitters 2

emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox hardware for the recommended standalone route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox backward-compatible version on modern hardware

primary.why: The original Xbox version is playable on Xbox One and Series X/S via backward compatibility, making it the best modern route for the full standalone game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Xbox release through Xbox backward compatibility; use the PS4/PS5 PS2 Classics release if you prefer trophies/rewind, or the Homefront hidden 4K build only as a curiosity.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS4/PS5 release is an enhanced PS2 classic; the Homefront 4K build is hidden inside another game.

entries.title: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect

emulation.notes: Use modern Xbox hardware for the recommended standalone route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox backward-compatible version on modern hardware

primary.why: Future Perfect's Xbox version is playable on Xbox One and Series X/S through backward compatibility; the original online multiplayer is documented but disabled, so the modern route is for campaign/local content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original Xbox version through Xbox backward compatibility; use the PS4/PS5 PS2 Classics release if you prefer trophies/rewind.

entries.remaster_caveats: PS4/PS5 release is an enhanced PS2 classic, not a remake.
